page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a manuscript note "243" in the right margin (handwriting, not transcribed); running head at top centre; page number at top right.

main_text.l: reon-eazan, quasi Visus oculi, à reon,
Sax. videre, & eaz; oculus, alias æpl;
unde nostratium Apple of the Eye.
fus, rigæpest: Mart autem hic in
Sig-tmart, à mæpe duclum arbitror, quod
gift] Sepulcrum nobis hodie a grave, à
jecturam probo, cum dormire, nobis sit
to sleep, à Sax. slapan. Sepulcrum hinc
Belg. spet, speet, unde forte nostrum
spit, Veru. Hasta autem Sax. rpepe,

page.notes: Old-German and Anglo-Saxon words are in black letter and Greek-like forms; several readings (e.g. "reofonpealo", "rigæpest", "rpepe", "manset") are uncertain. The handwritten "243" and the printed running head are as seen; the text is a glossary and some entries may be misread.
